# 1.0.7 beta 1

This beta is newer than the stable 1.0.5 release and supersedes the earlier 1.0.6 beta.

- Added an explicit update channel setting: Automatic, Stable or Beta.
- Automatic follows the build type: stable builds use stable releases, beta builds include prereleases.
- Stable checks ignore GitHub releases marked as prereleases and tags with a hyphenated prerelease suffix, so a stable installation cannot auto-update to a beta.
- Beta checks continue to include newer prereleases.
- Changing the channel immediately checks again and discards results from the previous channel.
- Existing settings migrate to schema 5 with the channel defaulting to Automatic.
- Added update-channel translations to all ten interface languages.

The stable 1.0.3 archive remains built from `release/v1.0.3`; this is the newest beta build.
